subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Analisar, entre os textos literários e entre estes e outras manifestações artísticas (como cinema, teatro, música, artes visuais e midiáticas), referências explícitas ou implícitas a outros textos, quanto aos temas, personagens e recursos literários e semióticos

components.description_pt: Identificar referências intertextuais explícitas a temas, personagens ou recursos literários entre textos
components.description_en: Identify explicit intertextual references to themes, characters, or literary resources across texts
components.cc_component_description: Identify similar themes or topics addressed across two or more texts

components.description_pt: Analisar relações intertextuais entre textos literários e outras expressões artísticas como cinema, música ou artes visuais
components.description_en: Analyze intertextual relationships between literary texts and other artistic expressions such as film, music, or visual arts
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the effect of film techniques such as lighting or camera angles on meaning

cc_matches.description: Analyze how two or more texts address similar themes or topics in order to build knowledge or to compare the approaches the authors take.

Compare and contrast a written story, drama, or poem to its audio, filmed, staged, or multimedia version, analyzing the effects of techniques unique to each medium (e.g., lighting, sound, color, or camera focus and angles in a film).
